<thought>The 13C NMR shows three signals in the aromatic region (≈110‑160 ppm): 161.40, 143.85, 130.30 ppm. Three distinct aromatic carbon signals typically arise from a para‑disubstituted benzene ring, where the six aromatic carbons are symmetry‑equivalent in three pairs. Therefore the molecule contains six aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
